description.value:
You've learned to split your attention between two powers at once.

If you're already concentrating on a power and cast another that also requires concentration, you can maintain both simultaneously, provided you spend your action each following round sustaining that dual concentration — otherwise you lose both.

At the end of each of your turns while concentrating on two powers, make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 10 plus the number of full rounds you've maintained both; failure ends both. As a free action on your turn, you may drop concentration on one power to avoid this save.

When damage would force a concentration save while you maintain two powers, the DC is 10 plus the combined levels of both powers, or half the damage taken, whichever is higher; failure ends both.

system.requirements: 4th level, the ability to cast force or tech powers.
